choices.label: Introductory rules (no trucks or sports cars)

name: Horseless Carriage
licenseInformation: Fan implementation; Horseless Carriage © Splotter Spellen BV 2022.
implementationNotes: The full game and the introductory rules (no trucks or sports cars), 3–5 players, audited rule by rule against the publisher's rulebook. Everyone builds at once in phase 3; when the shared supply runs short, engineering focus decides who keeps their pieces and the others rebuild. Where the rulebook is silent: price markers are $6, $4, $3 and $2; minimum specs have no upper limit; car meeples, sparks and spec indicators never run out; each colour set adds 6 research and 6 planning departments to the supply, and the two starting departments come from it; touching mainline sides of the same step form one manufacturing zone; floor expansions are rotated but never turned over; a market window may go anywhere within its dealer's specs, and sells nothing that turn if no buyer inside can be sold to; a player with no card they may play skips growing demand.
description: Industrialists build factories and sell the first automobiles to a market whose tastes change every year.
